backups.empty: No backups yet. Run one to get started.
backups.noDriverBanner: This database driver doesn't support in-app backups.

restore.dialogBody: This will replace all content, settings, and users with the backup from {{date}}, updated to this site's current database schema. A safety backup is taken automatically first so this can be undone, and backup history and schedule are kept. Everyone is signed out, you included, and any unsaved edits are lost.
restore.success: Restore complete. Everyone has been signed out, so sign in again to continue.

delete.dialogBody: The backup artifact will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
